author: Teri Scott
content: booked for a second time yesterday (9.4.23) for my little ones birthday. Great communication on the run up to the party and dealt with changes to the original plan amazingly. guys came out and set up promptly and came back and cleared away. very friendly and professional. Will definitely be booking again in the future. so many amazing packages and offers to choose from amd amazing prices. thank you USB events for making my party as amazing as it was.
